Common questions

Is the app really free?

Yes. The roadmap, games and lessons are free. Only the premium courses are paid.

How do I get a course?

Try the first chapter free in the app. If you want to continue, message me on WhatsApp and I'll send you the course password.

How do 1-to-1 lessons work?

Online, just you and Farin. The first lesson is free, then from ₺830 per lesson. 4, 8 or 12 lessons a month, your choice; pay 3 months at once and get 20% off the 8- and 12-lesson packs.
